maintainer.name: Gentoo network monitoring and analysis project

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Portsentry monitors network traffic to detect and respond to port scans and probing attempts in real-time. It can serve as a supplementary intrusion detection system (IDS) or as an enumeration-prevention tool, blocking bots and adversaries that probe unused services, especially when paired with a mostly-closed firewall.

use.flag: Use net-libs/libpcap for packet capture instead of Linux raw sockets
